question: Should OpenClaw support default-off WebChat-to-last-external mirroring as its own session policy, fold it into the broader origin-channel delivery policy, or keep WebChat isolated from external routes?
rationale: The request intentionally duplicates Control UI output into an external conversation selected from stored session route state, which affects product behavior and the security boundary.

options.title: Add explicit opt-in mirroring
options.body: Create a default-off session policy with route freshness, authorization, duplicate-delivery, failure, schema, docs, and live-channel proof requirements.

options.title: Fold into origin-channel policy
options.body: Keep this issue open as the WebChat scenario while the broader originating-channel delivery model is designed.

options.title: Keep WebChat isolated
options.body: Document explicit sends or channel docking as the supported bridge and do not add automatic mirroring.

recommendation.title: Add explicit opt-in mirroring
recommendation.body: Create a default-off session policy with route freshness, authorization, duplicate-delivery, failure, schema, docs, and live-channel proof requirements.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue is assigned to vincentkoc and current blame points to Vincent Koc on the relevant routing gates.
